statement: theorem lemma_4_13 (a₀ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (h₀ : 0 ≤ a₀) (ha : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ a t) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0)) (hmono : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 0)) (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ici 0, 0 ≤ f x) : (∑ t ∈ range T, a t * f (a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), a i)) ≤ ∫ x in a₀..(a₀ + ∑ i ∈ range T, a i), f x
